title: /llms.txt told answer engines to cite member counts below the social-proof floor, and gave them no help-category, city or operator-track URLs to walk

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by four scan-seven finders (geo-ai, seo-content, seo-help, seo-local), confirmed by hand

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven). Four independent finders read /llms.txt and each found a gap: the stats block published raw member and Circle counts with no floor, where every other public surface honours SOCIAL_PROOF_FLOOR (lib/site.ts), and called them the citable source; the file listed the /help hub and none of its ten categories; it listed /discover/cities and none of the live city landing URLs; it omitted the operator track (/spaces, /tools-for-community-builders); and it described /discover/places as third places when the page is Circles and events by city. CLOSED 2026-10-05: below the floor the people counts are withheld with a founding-stage line (the library and Pillar counts stay, because they size the catalog, not the crowd); a Help center section lists the categories and a Cities section lists the density-gated landing pages, both fail-safe to absent; the two operator pages join Key pages; the places line says what the page is. app/llms.txt/route.test.ts pins the floor and the help walk.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/llms.txt/route.ts","utf8");const miss=["async function helpSection","async function citiesSection","members < SOCIAL_PROOF_FLOOR","/tools-for-community-builders"].filter((k)=>!s.includes(k));if(miss.length){console.error("SCAN-662: /llms.txt is missing "+miss.join(", ")+": answer engines are told to cite member counts below the social-proof floor and are given no help-category or city landing URLs to walk.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
